observation.visible_scene: A macro/abstract view of colored ink dispersing in a clear fluid against a bright white background. A feathery blue mass with darker blue at the lower-left and pale cyan finger-like tendrils occupies the left side. From the middle of the excerpt onward a yellow-orange flower-like mass with a dense center and radiating pale-yellow petals occupies the right side.
visible_changes: Frames 1-15: only the blue mass is present; its edges and tendrils shift subtly (slow diffusion) while it stays anchored on the left with no large translation.
At frame 16 a yellow burst becomes visible on the right, absent in frame 15.

Frames 16-41: the yellow mass expands in place (its center stays roughly fixed while the diameter and petal reach grow), its petals extending outward and the overall footprint enlarging toward the left.
As the yellow grows, the white gap between the blue and yellow regions narrows; the blue mass remains on the left throughout, with only minor edge changes.
No object crosses the frame; changes are expansion/diffusion of the two colored regions rather than translation.
outside_clip_unknowns: What produced or preceded the blue formation before t=0 (it is already present at the start).
What caused the yellow shape to first appear at t~1.0 s (no drop, contact, or trigger is shown).
Whether the diffusion continues, merges, or stops after the last frame.
uncertain_details: Camera motion cannot be confirmed (background is featureless white); apparent changes are treated as fluid diffusion, not camera movement.
The physical medium (water, oil, etc.) and ink identities are not visible and are not asserted.
The blue and yellow regions do not visibly mix within the excerpt; their eventual interaction is unknown.
